en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

zh: 亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。

p.src: 1  We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

en: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
u.src: 1  We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

p.src: 2  When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

en: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
u.src: 2  When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

p.src: 3  The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

en: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
u.src: 3  The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

p.src: 4  I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

en: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
u.src: 4  I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

p.src: 5  Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

en: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
u.src: 5  Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

p.src: 6  For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
u.src: 6  For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

p.src: 7  But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

en: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
u.src: 7  But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

p.src: 8  For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

en: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
u.src: 8  For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

p.src: 9  But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

en: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
u.src: 9  But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

p.src: 10  I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

en: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
u.src: 10  I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
